description: Turn an app idea into an Offline Protocol plan: matching workflow, platform, packages, starter template and architecture documents, returned as text. Returns an error, not a guess, when the idea needs a framework no package supports (such as Flutter or native Swift) unless a platform is given.

platform.description: Optional platform override; inferred from the prompt otherwise
